title: A wrong password is refused and sets no session cookie (no partial auth)
An authenticated write with a forged/garbage session cookie is unauthenticated (401), not honoured
Logout invalidates the session server-side: the same cookie no longer works (401)
Session and CSRF tokens are stored hashed at rest: the raw cookie value is not found in the sessions table
evidence: raw cookie present true; rows matching raw value in sessions 0 (0 = stored hashed)

title: A client cannot pull a report outside the link's allowlist (shared: profit-loss; requested: balance-sheet) -> 403

A revoked link cannot start a sign-in (410)
